projects.name: CodeRisk Advisor
projects.description: Multi-agent AI security review system for Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript code. Combines OWASP Top 10 vulnerability scanning with AI-specific behavioral risk detection using a panel of specialized LLM agents that synthesize findings into conversational developer guidance.
projects.impact: Live production tool demonstrating applied multi-agent orchestration, adversarial review patterns, and structured LLM output in a security-critical domain.
highlights: LangGraph agent pipeline: VulnScanner, BehavioralRisk, Skeptic, Remediation, Synthesizer
Skeptic agent actively disputes low-confidence findings to reduce false positives
AI-specific behavioral risk detection covering hallucinated APIs, prompt injection, unsafe deserialization, and over-trust patterns
Token-by-token SSE streaming with real-time agent status updates in the UI
Session continuity via LangGraph MemorySaver checkpointer and X-Session-ID header
Deployed on Google Cloud Run with containerConcurrency: 1 to isolate in-process state
LangSmith tracing integrated for full observability across agent runs

projects.name: Portfolio Site — craigstueber.com
projects.description: A professional portfolio site built as a live demonstration of applied AI architecture. The site is a long-scroll React SPA with section-scoped AI agents accessible via per-section chat modals. Each section of the site (Experience, Education, Projects, Skills, Research, Writings) has its own chat context powered by a LangGraph backend. A separate Role Fit page allows visitors to paste a job description and receive a structured, honest fit assessment.
architectureHighlights: LangGraph backend deployed on Google Cloud Run (FastAPI + Python)
Fred agent handles all section-scoped chat with full facts always injected -- section_id shapes tone and focus via prompt instruction, not data boundary
Fred graph: retrieval → response → fact_check → drift_guard → guardrail
FactCheck node validates every draft response against authoritative facts before it exits the graph
DriftGuard node detects persona erosion across conversation turns
Guardrail node is a shared exit node on every graph -- strips hallucinated credentials, enforces third-person Fred persona, blocks boundary violations
Role Fit graph: jd_parser → profile_matcher → gap_analyst → synthesizer → guardrail
Cloudflare Workers as thin edge proxy between frontend and Cloud Run backend
Section history persisted in React local state per section, isolated across sections
Cross-section questions answered accurately with natural nudge toward the relevant section
